recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-32890 unless a new Pharmacy work group issue asks to restore a direct MedicationKnowledge packaging device element.
issue_request: FHIR-32890 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that MedicationKnowledge.packaging.device reference DeviceDefinition rather than Device because it described a model or kind of device, not a device instance.
initial_application: Commit 6cdd7b792e2241b7191584bd35915d4b0f9841f8, whose subject includes FHIR-32890, changed MedicationKnowledge.packaging.device from StructureDefinition/Device to StructureDefinition/DeviceDefinition. The cited rationale matched FHIR-32159, which had separately changed MedicationKnowledge.device to DeviceDefinition in commit 934e7819020c72ee6e3ba509ecb5445a1850f109.
additional_context: MedicationKnowledge is active in source/fhir.ini. A later refactor, commit 6422f2f98a0fcf03140c15fe93bfd6c765fc6377, removed the former packaging.device element and introduced MedicationKnowledge.packaging.packagedProduct as Reference(PackagedProductDefinition). Current source searches found no remaining MedicationKnowledge.packaging.device, MedicationKnowledge.device, or Reference(Device) target in MedicationKnowledge source. Confluence PHAR pages list FHIR-32890 and broader MedicationKnowledge/MedicinalProductDefinition discussion, and Zulip searches found no conflicting direct discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing or editing MedicationKnowledge.packaging.device would be incorrect for the current build because the element no longer exists, and package details now route through PackagedProductDefinition.
